title: Abelian varieties are de Rham $K(π,1)$
summary: Motivated by the work of Esnault-Hai, one has the notion of de Rham $K(π,1)$ schemes, defined as follows. Given a smooth proper geometrically connected scheme $X$ over a field $k$ of characteristic 0 and a base point $x \in X (k)$, one can define its differential fundamental group $π^{\mathrm{diff}}(X/k)$, which comes from the Tannakian duality of the category of coherent integrable connections on $X$.
